record_scope_reconstruction: Gaza de facto authorities imposed outward passenger restrictions at Arba-Arba, an internal approach checkpoint controlling access to Erez. It is distinct from the Israeli Erez facility; goods at Kerem Shalom were unaffected.

source_checks.finding: OCHA identifies Arba-Arba checkpoint, March 26 onset, rapid entry restoration and ongoing category-specific exit restrictions.
OCHA reports April 6 removal announcement; no all-category first passage observed.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Arba-Arba approach control only, March 26–April 6 exit regime.
unresolved: Exact Arba-Arba checkpoint coordinates not established. Existing Erez point cannot replace a distinct inland checkpoint.
